# DIGITACURVE

> Performance Marketing & Growth Agency turning ad spend into predictable leads, sales, and measurable revenue.

## Agency Overview
Digitacurve is an award-winning performance marketing agency in India. We engineer data-driven advertising systems across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Lead Generation, CRO, and Server-Side Analytics.

- **Primary Positioning**: Performance Marketing & Growth Agency
- **Core Tagline**: "Turn Ad Spend Into Predictable Growth."
- **Core Services Offered**:
  1. Google Ads & PPC Strategy (Search, PMax, Display, YouTube)
  2. Meta Ads & Paid Social (Instagram Reels, Facebook Feed)
  3. Predictable Lead Generation Systems
  4. Full Performance Marketing & Media Architecture
  5. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Landing Pages
  6. Omnichannel Remarketing
  7. GA4, GTM, CAPI & Server-Side Analytics
  8. AI-Powered Advertising
